bias.en: Uptrend under pressure · slipped under the 200-day, $201 held
bias.zh: 上升趋势承压 · 跌破 200 日均线，$201 守住

read.en: Nvidia fell 1.3% on Nov 2 to $202.06 (range $201.66–209.98) after a 4.2% drop on Oct 30. It is below the falling 5-day ($210.74), 10-day ($213.13) and 30-day ($222.82), the rising 100-day ($214.54) and, just, the rising 200-day ($204.46). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($218.40), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月2日下跌 1.3%，收于 $202.06（区间 $201.66–209.98），此前 10月30日下跌 4.2%。股价位于下行的 5 日（$210.74）、10 日（$213.13）和 30 日均线（$222.82）以及上行的 100 日均线（$214.54）下方，并略低于上行的 200 日均线（$204.46）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$218.40），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The close slipped under the 200-day, part of the $200.9–204.4 support, though the Oct 30 low held. Resistance is $204.5–204.6 (200-day, Oct 30 close), then $207.3–210 (Aug 24 and Sep 14 lows, Nov 2 high) and $213.1–214.5 (10 and 100-day). Support is $200.9–201.7 (Oct 30 and Nov 2 lows), then $198–199.3 and $190. A close above $210 would target $213–214.5; below $200.9, $198.

r.en: Aug 24 low $207.25; Sep 14 low $208.93; Nov 2 high $209.98
